name: Dunnage Settings Shell
summary: Card-based dunnage settings shell with a real user-preference page for default location plus per-user image preferences and a persisted default image-folder setting, persisted UI/UX controls for type and part image rendering, persisted workflow toggles for where Dunnage images appear, and placeholder overview, permissions, and audit pages.

userActions: Browse dunnage settings areas from the hub
Change the default Dunnage location used when guided entry leaves location blank
Choose the default folder used for Dunnage images
Control preferred Dunnage thumbnail size and part-image preference for the current user
Configure whether Dunnage type and part images appear in admin and workflow screens
Resolve mistyped default locations with fuzzy search against Infor Visual
Review placeholder guidance for future permissions and audit implementation
Inspect suggested controls for permissions and audit history
Understand which dunnage settings areas still need full implementation
preserveRules: Keep the placeholder status explicit for Dunnage settings pages that still lack persistence
Do not describe Permissions or Audit as fully implemented settings editors
Keep the existing navigation hub step list unchanged unless the code changes
acceptanceCriteria: The hub still routes to overview, preferences, UI/UX, workflow, permissions, and audit pages
Metadata makes it clear the Dunnage User Preferences page now persists a default Dunnage location, a default image folder, and image preferences
Metadata makes it clear the Dunnage UI/UX and Workflow pages now persist image-related settings
Metadata still calls out only Permissions and Audit as placeholder pages where persistence is not implemented
Metadata does not claim data persistence or business logic that the module does not implement
validationHints: Confirm the Dunnage User Preferences page saves and resets the default location for the active user
Confirm the Dunnage User Preferences page saves the default image folder only when the selected folder exists
Confirm the Dunnage User Preferences page saves preferred thumbnail size and preferred-image behavior for the active user
Confirm the Dunnage User Preferences page validates the configured location against Infor Visual warehouse 002 and offers fuzzy suggestions
Confirm the Dunnage UI/UX page saves image toggles, thumbnail size, file-size guidance, and visual source priority
Confirm the Dunnage Workflow page saves image-visibility toggles for type selection, part selection, and review
Confirm each dunnage card still opens the intended placeholder screen
Confirm titles and descriptions still match the current content for implemented and placeholder pages
Confirm metadata continues to describe only the remaining unimplemented pages as future-facing guidance
